card.name: Endings of except and withhold
card.fires_on: The ending added to 'except' (ing, ed, s), and the word 'withhold' or 'withheld' in dose-adjustment instructions. Also the ending of 'impeding'.

modes.label: Endings after except
modes.description: A verb ending attached to the stem 'except', as in excepting, excepted, excepts.
modes.example: there is not much you can do to prevent address spoofing except<<ing>> the normal spam filtering.
